nodes.label: Lava Pit Type Repair
nodes.rationale: A name-based wiki import classified the bundled Lava Pit as Rare because two duplicated wiki rows share that name. The user confirmed the bundled room is normal, so its hashes, secrets and crypts are retained with type NORMAL and imports can no longer reintroduce the error.

nodes.label: Bounded Custom Sound Mixer
nodes.rationale: Imported audio previously opened a device line and thread per cue and changed the device sample rate to pitch-shift. Playback now mixes a bounded number of voices into one fixed-rate stereo output with software pitch conversion, so decode work is bounded and stale cues are discarded.

nodes.label: Applied-Packet Sound Trigger
nodes.rationale: Sound triggers run after the corresponding client sound packet was applied, including bundled packets, so repeated Hyperion clicks no longer postpone an active Wither Shield expiry estimate.

nodes.label: Shared CA50 Solver
nodes.rationale: The GUI and chat commands share one profile loader, typed stats and CA50 solver instead of divergent copies. Selected profiles retain priority so an empty later profile cannot replace a selected one, and failed responses are errors rather than invented player data.

nodes.label: Mimic Map Marker Ambiguity
nodes.rationale: A single-room map marker is deliberately withheld when candidates occur in several rooms, while 2D waypoints may still appear. An unfiltered static chest can cause this, but without a trace it is not a proven diagnosis, so mapReason and mapRoom diagnostics were added instead of changing the filter.
